definitions.explanation: Having to do with or involving many different countries. Used to describe organizations, forces, or groups composed of members from multiple nations.

examples.japanese: {多国籍|たこくせき}{企業|きぎょう}で{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: To work at a multinational corporation.

examples.japanese: {多国籍|たこくせき}{軍|ぐん}が{派遣|はけん}された。
このチームは{多国籍|たこくせき}で、10か{国|こく}のメンバーが{参加|さんか}している。
examples.english: This team is multinational, with members from ten countries participating.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the fixed expression {多国籍|たこくせき}{企業|きぎょう} (multinational corporation). Also used in military and political contexts: {多国籍|たこくせき}{軍|ぐん} (multinational force).

Can function as a noun or a の-adjective to modify other nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多国籍|たこくせき}{企業|きぎょう}: multinational corporation
- {多国籍|たこくせき}{軍|ぐん}: multinational force
- {多国籍|たこくせき}の{社員|しゃいん}: employees of multiple nationalities
- {多国籍|たこくせき}チーム: multinational team
